gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Redodo's 24V 100Ah 'Group 31' trolling battery measures 13.11 × 6.93 × 9.45 in and that Redodo itself says it 'fits Group 31 trays only; not compatible with standard Group 31 battery boxes', while Redodo's 12V 120Ah Group 24 trolling battery 'fits group 24/27/31 battery boxes & trays'. So the one-cart Redodo kit can include Redodo's $92.99 Group 24/27/31 battery box only on the 12V route.
standout_why: I compared against the three pages ChatGPT cited and also read: the Minn Kota Trolling Motor Power Considerations page (battery count by thrust, 110 Ah per battery, 10 AWG leads, 5% voltage-drop limit, no mention of battery boxes) and the Minn Kota Deep Cycle Battery Selection page (at least 110 Ah, typically Group 27, 180-minute reserve capacity, no mention of battery boxes). I also read the uncited Minn Kota Lithium Battery Selection page (rank 6), which covers PCL charger maximum 14.5 V and the 85% speed limit on brushed motors but says nothing about box fit. The Minn Kota wiring guide (rank 1, cited) came back empty when fetched. ChatGPT's own answer lists Group 31 as 13.00 × 6.81 × 9.44 in and recommends a '24V 100Ah LiFePO4', which implies that one 24V lithium battery drops into a Group 31 box. Redodo's listing contradicts that for its 24V Group 31 battery. The finding is new and changes what goes in the cart. I scored it 2, not 3, because the box's own page returned HTTP 429, so I could not read its inside dimensions.
kit_items: Battery (12V motors up to 55 lb, per Minn Kota's one-12V-battery rule): Redodo 12V 120Ah Group 24 Trolling Motor Bluetooth Lithium Battery. Redodo rates it for 30–70 lb motors with a 120 A continuous BMS, and Redodo says it fits Group 24/27/31 boxes and trays.

Charger: Redodo 14.6V 20A LiFePO4 Battery Charger. It is built for 12V (12.8V) LiFePO4 with a pre-charge/CC/CV profile and can wake a battery whose BMS has shut off. Minn Kota's PCL onboard chargers top out at 14.5 V, so this charger avoids that mismatch.

Battery box (12V route only): Redodo Group 24/27/31 Portable Battery Box. It has a voltmeter, QC 3.0 USB-A and USB-C ports, two 12 V 15 A cigarette sockets and a 16 A breaker. The breaker covers only the DC ports, not the terminals.

24V route (55–80 lb motors): Redodo 24V 100Ah Group 31 Trolling Motor Bluetooth battery plus the Redodo 29.2V 20A MINI LiFePO4 charger, with no Group 31 box, because Redodo says this battery does not fit standard Group 31 battery boxes.
